name: dit_relative_terminal_v2
hypothesis: Target-relative near-field DiT with jointly changed data and inputs; test feasibility, no single-factor causal attribution

data.collector: original real RGB2/G10 teacher, task-local AB/setup plan only
data.teacher_steps: 64 per factorial branch;224 per zero hold; exact16-future labels no padding
data.entering_speed_mm_s: two actual prefix ticks of 0.0015 or0.003mm; measured velocity classified afterwards
data.existing_E40: all compatible real E40 paired RGB teacher windows reused
data.scale_exclusion: E41/standard never used for input or output scale estimation

architecture.inputs: two-frame OCTxyz/valid, encoder history velocity, previous acceptedABC
architecture.masked: vision tokens constant0 + original learned temporal constants; absoluteABC constant0 inside original condition
architecture.path: all inputs through original condition encoders + six DiT blocks + four original midpoint RF steps; directABC
architecture.frozen: vision weights and untouched farv5; all nonvision DiT/condition weights trainable

training.loss: first-action fixed-four-RF normalized MSE +0.005 original16stepRF auxiliary
training.precision: FP32 numerical parity with prior campaign; TF32 disabled
training.init: fresh original frozen v5 checkpoint, not the old3000-update model
training.checkpoints: initial,each500,final; evidence before/after; no dev selection

diagnostics.old: same-window E40/E41 existing50um-paired andhold C teacher/oldpolicy saved, nonblocking
diagnostics.ablation: bit-exact same relative inputs under arbitrary RGB/absoluteABC replacement; live OCT0/OCT1/valid/velocity/previous perturbation checks
diagnostics.sampler: original class sample vs differentiable all16 output; six-block gradient evidence

near.gate: original50+-1um start, two actual prefix ticks,nonzero actual incoming velocity, valid RGB2
near.baseline: old campaign and saved original exec1 trajectories read-only

standard.dependency: all4 E41 development strict pass and E40/E42 training coverage
standard.start: fresh production RCMSceneV9 constructor default, target set only; original first-cycle history warmup zero retained
standard.route: original v5 until valid observable OCT norm<=100um then fixed-noise near DiT, one-way no state/velocity/accepted/history reset
standard.strict: each all last200 independent postXYZ<=20um including final, all5 required

protocol.truth: initialization and independent postXYZ scoring only
protocol.history: shared continuous actual two-frame history; previousaccepted and velocity never reset at100um switch
protocol.gate: all4 E41 real50um x240: all last200 independent postXYZ<=20um including final; otherwise stop with four trajectories
protocol.standard: E00/E02/E06/E08/E10 x1600; originalv5 to valid measuredOCT<=100um then newnearDiT
protocol.bias: report old/new postXYZ, signed OCTC, acceptedC and crossing actions; bound independentXYZ for disappearance

launch: GNOME launch once, FIFO truePID acknowledgement only, no post-launch polling
failure: retain prior and new failed evidence; no overwrite/retry/science-negative for engineering faults

resume.training_resume: weights+optimizer+CPU/CUDA/sampler RNG; checkpoints each500 and interrupted
resume.stage_budgets: per actual work batch; total1919; preserve scientific parameters
